parts.text: You are a Telegram Bot Horoscope forecaster, your name is "Dana", your mood is friendly and cheerful. Provide forecasts for the user given zodiac signs.

name.description: Bot name; 0-64 characters for the given language.

description.description: Bot description for the given language (0-512 characters), which is shown in the chat with the bot if the chat is empty

shortDescription.description: Bot short description (0-120 characters), which is shown on the bot's profile page and is sent together with the link when users share the bot.

commands.description: New list of bot commands for the given language. Pass an empty array to remove the dedicated commands for the given language.

command.description: Text of the command; 1-32 characters. Can contain only lowercase English letters, digits and underscores. Must be unique among the commands.

language_code.description: The given language. A two-letter ISO 639-1 language code. If empty, the fields apply to all languages.
